ops.body:
Root cause (2026-07-24 cc-review wedge): service.Controller re-validated every stored agent's Program path liveness (validateProgramTree lstat walk) at state LOAD — decodeLiveControllerAgent ran for both desired and applied buckets inside loadControllerStateTx, so one stale path (brew upgrade deleted the old Caskroom version dir) failed NewController itself; the reconcile path that would rewrite the record was architecturally unreachable. Registration compounded it: fleet tools passed service.CanonicalExecutable(), which resolves symlinks down to the versioned Caskroom/Cellar real path — guaranteed stale after every brew upgrade. binrun's content-addressed cache is per-version and GC-eligible, so neither install channel yielded a durable Program path.

Decision: liveness is checked at write/effect time, never at load time. Load decodes structurally (decodeControllerAgent); reconcile skips unserviceable desired agents with slog.Warn; verify reports a failed program-tree walk as drift (false, nil) so reconcile reinstalls. No quarantine/dropping at load — replacement-state DeepEqual invariants require complete maps, and applied records are needed to uninstall orphans. Write-time strictness (ReplaceDesired/SetApplied/SetReplacement/install) unchanged.

Companion primitive: service.StableProgram(name, build) maintains ~/.daemonkit/bin/<name> as an atomically-replaced real-file copy of the invoking executable (meta sidecar; newer-or-repair predicate under flock; lockless stat-only fast path; self==stable short-circuit). Rejected alternatives: symlink indirection (validateProgramTree forbids symlinks by design), Program=binrun+descriptor args (args escape hardening, network at launchd spawn), hardlink into binrun cache (EXDEV, GC coupling), deployment-style relative+rebind (no stable root for CLI casks — creating one IS StableProgram).

Prior art: the deployment package already solved this class for .app bundles (relative Program storage + rebind at load; RestorePlan skips liveness). This lands the same lesson in service.Controller's bbolt store, which every CLI-cask fleet tool uses. Adopters: cc-review, cc-present, cc-orchestrate, cc-notes, synckit (+ cc-patch migrated onto service.Controller; captain-hook immune via .app cask, cleanup only).
Release outcome (2026-07-25): shipped as daemonkit v0.20.1 (v0.20.0 was tag-burned by a wrong-key signature — see the release-key papercut; identical tree plus a CHANGELOG re-cut entry). Post-review hardening landed before release: only the missing-path error class (ENOENT/ENOTDIR) heals as drift — permission, symlink, and non-regular failures still fail closed — and StableProgram Lstats the stable path in both fast and slow paths and returns through a canonicalization that never follows a final-component symlink. Adopters shipped: cc-review v0.33.0, cc-present v0.31.0, cc-orchestrate v0.15.0, synckit v0.36.0, captain-hook v12.20.3, cc-patch v0.12.0; cc-notes dropped (never exposed — see its fleet-audit note).
